items: 4 cups raw corn (about 5 ears, cut from the cob, or you can use frozen or (rinsed and patted dry) canned)
½ medium red bell pepper, finely diced
½ small red onion, finely diced
½ cup cotija cheese (or feta, crumbled)

steps.title: Cut the corn
steps.body: Cut the corn off the cob (**5 ears** should produce about **4 cups**). You can use canned or frozen corn (if using frozen, no need to thaw it out).

steps.title: Char the corn
steps.body: Heat **1 Tbsp olive oil** in a large skillet over high heat. Add the corn and stir it around. Cook for about 3-5 minutes, or until the corn starts to char (why to use high heat). If using frozen corn, this will take a couple extra minutes.

steps.title: Cool the corn
steps.body: Transfer the corn to a large bowl and let it cool for a couple minutes.

steps.title: Mix in the rest
steps.body: To the same bowl, add **½ medium red bell pepper** (finely diced), **½ small red onion** (finely diced), **½ cup cilantro** (chopped), **6 green onions** (chopped), **1 jalapeno pepper** (finely diced), **½ avocado** (finely diced), **4 Tbsp lime juice**, **½ tsp cumin**, **½ tsp smoked paprika**, **¼ tsp black pepper**, **¼ tsp salt**, **2 Tbsp sour cream** (or plain yogurt), **2 Tbsp mayonnaise** and **½ cup cotija cheese** (or feta, crumbled). Stir everything together until well combined. Adjust lime juice and salt and pepper as necessary.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: To serve, garnish with additional cheese and cilantro, if preferred. Eat with chips, alongside any Mexican food, or on its own!
